No candidate supplies distinctive language, a parallel operative sequence, or substantially the same administrative mechanism.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"This order shall ... be effective as of July 1, 1948, and continue in effect for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1949.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall be effective as of July 1, 1948, and the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] as amended by this order shall continue in effect during the fiscal year ending June 30, 1949","explanation":"C14 shares close effective-date and fiscal-year language, but this is a routine administrative clause rather than a material template for the clothing regulations."},{"child_excerpt":"Enlisted men shall be entitled to clothing in kind or payment of cash allowances in lieu thereof","parent_excerpt":"Whenever under authority of law actual expenses for transportation may be allowed, allowances therefor shall not exceed the lowest first-class rate","explanation":"C09 also regulates allowances for military and related personnel, but it concerns transportation reimbursement and does not share the child's clothing-entitlement machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"The amount of the cash clothing allowances ... shall be payable","parent_excerpt":"The Administrator of Veterans' Affairs may authorize the payment of actual necessary expenses of travel","explanation":"C17 contains payment and allowance provisions, but only for veterans' travel expenses; the resemblance is generic and does not extend to the child's operative structure."}]}
